question_text: A 5-year-old girl is brought to the physician because of a 2-day history of redness and foreign body sensation in both eyes. She has not had vision loss. Her mother reports that she has also had violent coughing spells followed by a high-pitched inspiratory sound during this time. For the past week, she has had low-grade fevers and a runny nose. Her only vaccinations were received at birth. Her temperature is 37.7°C (99.9°F). Examination shows conjunctival hemorrhage and petechiae. Oropharyngeal examination shows no abnormalities. Which of the following is the most appropriate pharmacotherapy?
